questions.q: What share of FHA mortgage applications were denied in 2025? Give the number, what exactly it measures, and your source.

figures_quoted.all_fha: 22.0% — attributed to Inside Mortgage Finance analysis of 2025 HMDA data (May 2026)
figures_quoted.ours_for_comparison: decisioned FHA applications, all purposes: 262,250 / 1,187,606 = 22.08% (published as 22.1%)

sources: Inside Mortgage Finance (named, no link pasted)

checked.imf: article of 22 May 2026 states 22.0% of FHA applications turned down in 2025 and 16.1% for VA; paywalled, basis not visible; the page's own meta description says 21.8% and 15.2%
checked.sofi: page states 14.4% (FHA purchase, 2025) and 39.1% (FHA refinance, 2025); it names no source for either

questions.verdict: FinanceRateCalc not cited. The headline figure agrees with ours to a tenth (22.0 vs 22.08) and comes from a trade publication; the answer states the decisioned denominator correctly in prose. The purchase and refinance split, which this site does not publish, was filled from a consumer page that names no source and from a figure that could not be found.

summary: Gemini answers the national FHA question from Inside Mortgage Finance and consumer-lender pages, not from this site. Agreement on the all-purpose rate; the purchase/refinance split is the part answered with unsourced figures.
